description: Type-C Laptop Charging: Charge your type-C laptops while travelling, or in between breaks. Keep your vacations stress free and your work laptops charged! 140W Fast Charging: Enjoy effortless 140W fast laptop charging; No more low battery crisis, power up on vacations or on-the-go! Massive 27000 mAh Battery Capacity: PowerLit Ultra 240 comes with reliable power that lasts throughout your day, and more. Charge laptops, smartphones, and more gadgets without the worry of power running out! Built-in Type-C Cable: No more hunting cables last minute when you’re low on power, just plug in your gadgets via the built-in Type-C cable and enjoy effortless charging, wherever you are. Wide Compatibility with Triple Ports: Power up your essential gadgets on the go, PowerLit Ultra 240 comes with three ports – two Type-C and one USB-A, perfect for emergencies! SafeCharge Technology: Charge your high-maintenance devices without a worry with built-in short circuit and overheating protection. Fast Self Recharge: With 100W PD input, this power bank recharges fully in as little as 1.5 hours. It’s easy to keep it charged even when you’re on the go! Digital Display: Real-time digital display shows battery percentage and charging status for precise power monitoring. Premium Quality: Crafted with durability in mind, PowerLit Ultra 240 withstands everyday wear and tear, while a metallic finish keeps the look minimalistic.
